title: Fix data race in overrun warning parameter by Quchaosheng · Pull Request #1 · Quchaosheng/ros2_control · GitHub
body_rendered_text:
Fixes ros-controls#3612.


Summary



Cache overruns.print_warnings in an atomic snapshot.


Refresh the snapshot whenever the controller-manager parameter set is initialized or reloaded.


Read the snapshot from the real-time write() loop with relaxed ordering.



Motivation


The diagnostic callbacks replace the shared parameter snapshot while the real-time loop reads the warning flag. This produces a ThreadSanitizer-reported data race. The atomic cache keeps the real-time path lock-free while preserving runtime parameter updates.


Testing



git diff --check


Reviewed all parameter-refresh paths and the real-time read path.


Full ROS 2/ThreadSanitizer build was not run because the available ROS installation does not match the repository distribution dependencies.
